scope: Audit of the native B-buy/A-sell/N-unknown full-RTH delta reconstruction and cache ownership. This artifact records one real native-data comparison and identifies pre-rewrite report caches that are not valid inputs to scan_rth_delta.

source_policy: Read immutable native trade members resolved by collect_window.
Use the native instrument definition for tick size and contract identity.
Map B to buy, A to sell, and N or an unrecognized side to unknown.
Retain unknown volume in total volume and signed-volume coverage; do not coerce it into a signed side.
Use cross-source OHLCV only as corroborating reconciliation evidence.
Do not read, merge, or overwrite any legacy report-table cache.

signed_extrema.reason: Unknown executions and unresolved cross-source reconciliation prevent a faithful signed-extrema flag. Provisional known-side and all-volume candidates remain visible for review.

legacy_caches.reason: Pre-rewrite scalar full-RTH cache with the legacy A/B convention; it does not preserve native B-buy/A-sell/N-unknown semantics or the native evidence boundary.
CVD report-table cache is a legacy derived summary, not an immutable native-member reconstruction and has no signed-flow-version guarantee.
Legacy flow/CVD SMT report table is not a canonical native delta cache and cannot certify side, identity, coverage, or price-grid provenance.
Legacy MBP1 flow table is a downstream report cache and is excluded from the native scanner input boundary.

checks: B maps to positive signed volume, A maps to negative signed volume, and N remains unknown.
Unknown volume contributes to total volume and lowers signed-volume coverage.
Prices off the native tick grid are rejected instead of rounded.
Changing or monkeypatching load_rows cannot make scan_rth_delta read a legacy cache.

interpretation: This is a retrospective native comparison artifact. The June 12 cross-source mismatches keep coverage unresolved, so it is not a verified historical source profile, entry reconstruction, or performance result.
